periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique downward-lateral orientation at approximately 45 degrees relative to the median facial plane.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward expansion creating a teardrop-like taper toward the lower-outer boundary of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped profile along the posterior margin of the dark band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Wide transverse band occupying approximately 25-30% of the visible dorsal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation approximately equivalent to 1.5 to 2 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High curvature smoothness with distinct, semi-circular rounded tops.
